queries_run: AXT Inc AXTI indium phosphide market share competitors 2026
InP substrate new entrant competitor Sumitomo JX Coherent capacity expansion 2026

findings.claim: 10-K 列出主要對手為 Sumitomo、JX、Freiberger、Umicore、CCTC、Vital Materials；稱競爭強度過去幾年增加、預期持續增加，競爭壓力已造成價格下降，可能壓縮份額與毛利。
findings.excerpt: The level and intensity of competition has increased over the past years and we expect competition to continue to increase in the future. Competitive pressures have resulted in reductions in the prices of our products, and continued or increased competition could reduce our market share, require us to further reduce the prices of our products, affect our ability to recover costs and result in reduced gross margins and profitability.

findings.claim: 10-K 稱客戶通常至少有兩家合格基板供應商；InP 與低 EPD GaAs 競爭者較少，品質為關鍵因素。
findings.excerpt: Other products, such as InP and low EPD GaAs wafers, have fewer competitors and quality is a key competitive factor in addition to price.

findings.claim: 10-K：中國鎵供應商（合資企業所處）為爭奪國內市占而降價，合資企業權益收益由 3.4 百萬美元降至 0.8 百萬美元。
findings.excerpt: Further, gallium suppliers in China reduced their pricing as they competed for market share within their domestic market.

findings.claim: JX Advanced Metals 計畫投資至多 1,200 億日圓至 FY2030，InP 產能擴至最多 10 倍。
findings.excerpt: [News] JX Advanced Metals to Invest JPY 120B Through FY2030, Expand InP Capacity Up to 10x on CPO Demand 2026-06-16 Emerging Technologies editor

findings.claim: 中國新進入者（雲南鍺業、Vital Materials）擴 InP 產能；InP 基板瓶頸加劇。
findings.excerpt: Yunnan Germanium: Officially initiated a high-quality InP single-crystal wafer project with a total investment of CNY 189 million in April 2026. The expansion targets an additional annual capacity of 300,000 InP wafers, bringing the company’s total annual output to 450,000 wafers, primarily serving mid-to-low-end transceivers and standard telecom components. Vital Materials/ Guangdong

note: 搜尋摘要（非逐字）顯示：JX Advanced Metals 計畫四年投資至多 1,200 億日圓、InP 產能擴 7–10 倍（2026-06）；Sumitomo 投資約 180 億日圓；中國新進入者（雲南鍺業、Vital/先導）擴 InP 產能；Lumentum/Coherent 自建 InP 可能減少對 AXT 採購。市占估計 12%／40%／AXT+Sumitomo 約 80% 互相衝突，未獨立驗證。 線索 2 條，程式核實 2 條
